ABPN lists neurology subspecialty certificates separately; this course covers general adult neurology, not a fellowship certificate. The December 2025 initial certification outline specifies 80% adult and 20% child neurology items; this adult-only course does not cover the child portion and is not comprehensive preparation for the full examination. boardEligibilityNotice: Self-study confers no board eligibility. The ABPN page checked 2026-10-07 lists the Oct 5–9, 2026 examination (currently in progress on the check date), its application deadlines as passed, and 2028 as the next choice of dates. ABPN lists post-practice-pathway training requirements after the 2021–2026 practice pathway; candidates must verify the relevant sponsoring primary board's rules. The program's ACGME accreditation and UCNS accreditation do not confer certification or candidate eligibility.
boardEligibilityNotice: This course neither establishes nor evaluates board eligibility. ABPN eligibility depends on primary-board certification and the candidate's training pathway and sponsoring-board rules; UCNS has separate requirements. ABPN's transitional practice pathway is described for examination administrations 2021–2026; do not assume it applies to a later exam. Confirm current details directly with ABPN/one's primary board and UCNS. Johns Hopkins program admission prerequisites are not board exam eligibility.
